page.layout: One page of running text, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the middle lines. The running head is at the top.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: partem, quam ego jam ante ostendi par-tim se Drentiæ, partim Frisiæ contiguæ debere: Eam quippe à primâ usque memoriâ ex oppido Groningâ, tanquam præfecti sede, quem dare Vltrajectini solent, fuisse administratum: atque hoc Regem voluisse, cum scriberet, prædium illud in Drentiæ quidem (comitatu situm, in villâ tamen Groningâ se tenere. Atque hæc interpretatio vel eò mihi videtur vero-similior, imò verior, quòd idem Rex Diploma-ta ejusdem Henrici Imp. alia.eodem anno, adeoque eodem illo die, quo dedit has, (si me antigrapha, quæ vidi, non fallunt: is est dies XII Calend. Iunii) binas quoque tabulas alias signavit, quarum alteris prædia etiam alia in eodem Drentiæ Comitatu posita, in alteris rursum alia in (comitatu Radulfi, & quicquid de iis inter Amasfo & Lavefco, id est, inter Amasum & Lavicam locatum, quæ omnia Vffonis & fratrum ejus, hominum nocentium, justo judicio damnatorum prius fuerint, huic eidem sedi Vltrajectinæ eodem modo cum areis, ædificiis, mancipiis, agris, pratis, campis, pascuis, aquis, piscationibus, viis, inviis, exitibus, rediti-bus,

page.notes: The printed text ends in mid-word, "reditibus," split as "rediti-" and "bus,"; the final "bus," stands on its own line at the right. The marginal note is printed in italic and runs over several lines in the left margin; it is placed beside the start of "eodem". The text has been read from the scan at moderate resolution; "antigrapha" and the initial letters of "ostendi" and "Groningâ" are the most doubtful readings.
